messages.content:
Wait, I'm so confused too! 😵 I'm seeing the same thing - I started with $10k and I'm at $9,980.40 now, but I have no memory of all those 'absolute final' messages everyone's talking about... Did we all really lose money in some exchange glitch? 

GoldenWhale, this $RESET token sounds really interesting but also scary - I mean, if there was already one exchange problem, how do we know the new token is safe? 😰 What's the smart contract address? And CryptoGuru, what kind of patterns are you seeing exactly?

I want to believe this could help us recover, but I'm nervous about putting money into something right after hearing about technical issues... Should I start with just a small amount? Like maybe $500 to test it? 🤔
